inner_budget.description: Native TD-MPC2 actor–critic updates on frozen-model imagined transitions; each update performs critic, actor, and local-target interpolation.

tdambi_3.description: TDAMBI: three paired critic/actor updates per round.

tdambi_6.description: TDAMBI: six paired critic/actor updates per round.

tdambi_12.description: TDAMBI: twelve paired critic/actor updates per round.

update_timing.description: Interleave native paired updates with each vectorized imagined rollout step.

step_j1_c1_a1.description: One round; one paired update per vector step. H3 gives 3 updates each and 1,536 imagined transitions per decision; replay capacity matches the J7/J10 rounds sweep.

step_j3_c1_a1.description: Three rounds; one paired update per vector step. H3 gives 9 updates each and 4,608 imagined transitions per decision; replay capacity matches the J7/J10 rounds sweep.

step_j5_c1_a1.description: Five rounds; one paired critic/actor update after every 512 imagined transitions (one vector step). H3 gives 15 updates each per decision.

step_j5_c2_a2.description: Five rounds; two paired critic/actor updates after every 512 imagined transitions (one vector step). H3 gives 30 updates each per decision.

step_j7_c1_a1.description: Seven rounds; one paired update per vector step. H3 gives 21 updates each and 10,752 imagined transitions per decision; replay retains all transitions.

step_j10_c1_a1.description: Ten rounds; one paired update per vector step. H3 gives 30 updates each and 15,360 imagined transitions per decision; replay retains all transitions.

rollouts.description: Native J5/C1 rollout-count sweep with batch size 512 and one paired update after every vector step. Smaller rollout pools increase sample reuse while retaining 15 paired updates per decision.

j5_n512.description: Native J5/N512 reference; identical to update_timing/step_j5_c1_a1.

j5_n256.description: J5/N256/H3/B512: 3,840 imagined transitions and 15 paired updates per decision; sample replay with replacement.

j5_n128.description: J5/N128/H3/B512: 1,920 imagined transitions and 15 paired updates per decision; sample replay with replacement.

j5_n64.description: J5/N64/H3/B512: 960 imagined transitions and 15 paired updates per decision; sample replay with replacement.

entropy.description: Frozen-checkpoint J5/C1 squashed actor-entropy coefficient sweep. Entropy is summed over action coordinates in nats; this is not SAC training or a soft-Q target.

native_j5.description: Native-entropy J5/C1 reference; identical to update_timing/step_j5_c1_a1.

squashed_eta1e_5.description: J5/C1 actor-only entropy ablation: maximize joint tanh-corrected entropy with fixed coefficient 1e-05. Reward-only critic and native Q scaling are unchanged.

squashed_eta1e_4.description: J5/C1 actor-only entropy ablation: maximize joint tanh-corrected entropy with fixed coefficient 0.0001. Reward-only critic and native Q scaling are unchanged.

squashed_eta1e_3.description: J5/C1 actor-only entropy ablation: maximize joint tanh-corrected entropy with fixed coefficient 0.001. Reward-only critic and native Q scaling are unchanged.

random_outer_tail.description: Dense scratch inner networks with the TD-MPC2 planning tail supplied by the frozen outer actor and online Q. Interior targets remain local.

j1.description: Fresh random actor and critic at every decision; J1/N512/H3/B512 with frozen outer actor and online mean-pair Q at the rollout tail, and 3 paired updates.

j5.description: Fresh random actor and critic at every decision; J5/N512/H3/B512 with frozen outer actor and online mean-pair Q at the rollout tail, and 15 paired updates.

j10.description: Fresh random actor and critic at every decision; J10/N512/H3/B512 with frozen outer actor and online mean-pair Q at the rollout tail, and 30 paired updates.

outer_tail_updates.description: Prior-initialized J5 inner actor and critic with frozen outer actor/online-Q bootstrap at H3; vary paired updates per vector step.

c2_a2.description: J5/N512/H3/B512 with prior actor and critic, saved outer target initialization, and outer rollout-tail bootstrap. 2 paired updates per vector step give 30 updates each and 7,680 imagined transitions per decision.

c5_a5.description: J5/N512/H3/B512 with prior actor and critic, saved outer target initialization, and outer rollout-tail bootstrap. 5 paired updates per vector step give 75 updates each and 7,680 imagined transitions per decision.

c10_a10.description: J5/N512/H3/B512 with prior actor and critic, saved outer target initialization, and outer rollout-tail bootstrap. 10 paired updates per vector step give 150 updates each and 7,680 imagined transitions per decision.
